title: IIT Kharagpur will offer MD degrees from 2026-27 after National Medical Commission approval (applied in March, per ThePrint); officials told PTI it is the first IIT to do so. 12 seats, two each in General Medicine, Radiology, Physiology, Pathology, Community Medicine and Biochemistry, based at its Dr B.C. Roy Multi-Speciality Medical Research Centre; admission through NEET-PG 2026 online counselling, with officials telling PTI the seats are on offer in Round 2. MCC's revised Round 2 schedule: registration closes 3 pm Sat 14 Nov; choice filling and locking close 11:55 pm Sun 15 Nov; final result 17 Nov. Director Suman Chakraborty: 'clinical excellence meets engineering ingenuity'. ThePrint: IIT Madras, Jodhpur and Delhi run medical-technology programmes, none a clinical MD.
